children: The Changing Objectives effect represents a more significant shift in the heroes' situation than usual. As the heroes accrue Successes and Failures, the objectives of the

and Actions available to the heroes change as well. For example, you might use this effect when the heroes learn that the quarry they have been chasing actually needs their protection, or when the crime lord they have been negotiating with decides to turn them over to the authorities, forcing the characters to flee.
Use the Changing Objectives Effect when:
You want to combine two scenes into a single
You have heroes with wildly different skill sets.
